'''Britt''' was an [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial Stormtrooper]] who was stationed on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] among the forces of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ozzik Sturn]] by [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].

One day he was patrolling with a companion around the vicinity of Sturn's quarters, 

[[Galen Marek]] arrived to the planet in order to [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|rescue]] [[Leia Organa/Legends|Leia Organa]] held captive. After traversing the huge trees of the planet, he detected the Stormtroopers and with a jump landed among them, immediately putting Britt to sleep with a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]], then affecting his companion's mind in order to help him, although he couldn't explain what happened to Britt.
